title: Specify paper-derived requirements and adversarially review the implementation plan
body: Read both papers and current Pi documentation. Commit PLAN.md, a paper-to-code requirements map and an explicit adversarial plan review before implementation. Acceptance: each harness mechanism has an implementation target and a verification method; adaptations and non-replication boundaries are explicit.

title: Build validated research state, branch-safe checkpoints and dependency graph operations
body: Implement strict state schemas, immutable content-addressed checkpoints, dependency validation, transitive invalidation and research provenance. Acceptance: tests reject cycles/missing dependencies/corruption; independent branches remain isolated and unaffected proof sections survive repairs.

title: Implement bounded model inference and critique-preserving overlapping aggregation
body: Build a provider-neutral worker interface, shared concurrency/call/output budgets, cancellation, independent candidate generation, targeted falsification and seeded overlapping random-sample aggregation. Acceptance: adversarial tests cannot erase objections, race budgets, silently retry or accept malformed model output.

title: Implement exploration, readiness, proof planning, local retries and global revision
body: Connect stage inference to a state machine with explicit proof obligations, human route/plan gates, dependency-eligible section work, local review, whole-proof verification, localized revisions and re-exploration. Retain prior drafts and a sourced knowledge directory. Acceptance: complete workflow tests cover rejection, retries, descendant invalidation and preservation of unrelated work.

title: Implement conjecture discovery with weighted data patches and executable proof feedback
body: Build a typed exact-integer expression language, feature-spotter/scaffolder pipeline, skeptical patch reweighting, feedback-controlled conjecturing, nondegeneracy checks, certified linear algebra and optional deterministic Lean translation. Acceptance: false finite examples, vacuity, unknown prover outcomes, unsafe inputs and proof/premise mismatch are tested; all trajectories are exportable.

title: Expose the research workbench as a Pi extension with human controls
body: Register tools and slash commands, use the real model registry, persist and restore current-branch checkpoints, inject compact research context, display progress and export Markdown/LaTeX/JSON. Human approval and premise promotion must be command-only. Acceptance: real Pi loader, API contract and lifecycle tests pass.

title: Add reproducible mathematical examples, ablations, CI and user/reviewer documentation
body: Provide offline examples, seeded ablation experiments, installation/tutorial/API/architecture/evidence docs and CI. Acceptance: a fresh checkout can run all checks without model credentials; demonstrations distinguish fixtures from actual computations and mathematical claims from software checks.

title: Adversarially review the implementation and reconcile release evidence
body: Perform an adversarial code review against the plan findings; add regression tests for defects; record test results and limitations; publish incremental commits and reconcile GitHub issues. Acceptance: clean typecheck, full tests, package load and reproducible demo; no unsupported claims about live models, Lean or paper reproduction.
